correctness.rationale: The standard-library verifier reconstructs the exact graph, compares all 2^18 vertex subsets under two independent face predicates, confirms 8,564 faces and 108 forbidden triples, constructs 4,273 disjoint face-poset pairs, and proves the oriented full 42,786-edge Hasse diagram acyclic by exhaustive topological sorting. The only critical cells are one in degree zero and seventeen in degree five. By integral discrete Morse theory this is a CW model with one 0-cell and 17 5-cells, necessarily a wedge of 17 five-spheres. Exact direct mod-2 boundary ranks independently support the same Betti vector. The script is inside this package, not referenced from another execution.

value.rationale: A concrete result on a specifically posed, still unclassified triple categorical product family (Carnero Bravo Question 44). This first balanced non-degenerate case has an exact integral homotopy type with 17 degree-five generators, contrasting the independently known first filtration level zero with 14 three-spheres. It supplies a motivated exact cutoff with no claim of a general formula.
